notes.Tristan da Silva: Paolo Banchero is out four to six weeks with a high ankle sprain, and da Silva is expected to start, though he mostly adds threes.
notes.Anthony Black: He is questionable with an ankle injury, but Paolo Banchero is out for weeks, so Orlando needs his ball-handling if he plays.
notes.Paul Reed: Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain, and Reed starts after scoring 19 points with 11 rebounds in 26 minutes when Duren left Friday.
notes.Ron Holland: Ausar Thompson is questionable with an ankle sprain, and Holland gets more minutes if he sits.
notes.LeBron James: He sat Saturday with back soreness, and Philadelphia has not posted his status for tonight yet.
notes.Joel Embiid: He played 36 minutes Saturday and usually sits one night of back-to-backs, and his status for tonight is not posted yet.
notes.VJ Edgecombe: He had 17 points, 13 rebounds and two blocks in 30 minutes on Saturday. Philadelphia has not posted whether Joel Embiid or LeBron James plays on the second night of the back-to-back.
notes.Keon Ellis: He started Saturday and played 22 minutes. Mikel Brown Jr. sits the second night of the back-to-back, which keeps Ellis in a bigger role.
notes.Tyrese Haliburton: He plays today and is likely to sit Monday on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Precious Achiuwa: He is playing about 27 minutes a night with Maxime Raynaud out.
notes.Kris Dunn: He starts next to Darius Garland as the second ball-handler and has played 27 and 34 minutes. The Clippers are without Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal and Max Strus.
He is playing mid-30s in minutes while Brandon Ingram is out.
notes.Zach Edey: Memphis is limiting his minutes and plays again Monday, so he could sit one of the two nights.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He has played 36 and 35 minutes in his two games, and the Clippers come in without Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal and Max Strus. Oklahoma City is a 15.5-point favorite, so a blowout could cut his fourth quarter.
notes.Cade Cunningham: Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain, so Detroit leans even harder on Cade, who has eight assists in both games. Philadelphia is on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Tyrese Maxey: He has played 40, 42 and 36 minutes, and Philadelphia is on the second night of a back-to-back with LeBron James and Joel Embiid not yet confirmed. If either sits, his usage climbs again.
notes.Anthony Edwards: He scored 45 points in the opener, then 15 in 33 minutes on Friday. Donte DiVincenzo is out, and the game has a high 232.5-point total.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He played 37 minutes with 10 rebounds on Friday after only 24 in the opener. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero, which thins its frontcourt.
notes.Anfernee Simons: He has come off the bench for 25, 17 and 20 minutes. His value depends on LeBron James, whose status for tonight is not posted yet.
notes.Isaiah Joe: He has played 19 and 18 minutes off the bench, and Jalen Duren is out tonight. He is a three-point specialist who hit 42% from deep last season.
notes.Nikola Vucevic: He has played only five and four minutes behind Wendell Carter Jr. Paolo Banchero being out could open frontcourt minutes, but nothing he has done on the court so far shows a bigger role.
notes.Dean Wade: He started for LeBron James on Saturday in his first game back from an ankle injury and played 28 minutes with three steals. If James sits again tonight, Wade should start again.
notes.Cason Wallace: He has started both games but played only 19 and 24 minutes, with Alex Caruso, Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain all taking big bench roles. The 15.5-point spread adds blowout risk.
notes.Kevin Huerter: He has played 18 and 20 minutes off the bench, with six rebounds on Friday. With Jalen Duren out, Detroit has one fewer big in the rotation.
He scored 28 points with four threes in 33 minutes at Cleveland on Saturday, and Brooklyn plays again tonight on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Egor Demin: He started Saturday and scored 22 points, 15 in the fourth quarter, in 31 minutes. Mikel Brown Jr. sits tonight, so Demin should run more of the offense.
